findings.title: Phase 4 gate overdue day counts stale across 6 locations (56→59 days, 70→73 days elapsed, 2026-07-30→2026-08-02)
findings.detail: All six tracked occurrences of the Phase 4 gate overdue counter were last updated 2026-07-30 (56 days overdue, 70 days elapsed). As of 2026-08-02 the correct values are 59 days overdue and 73 days elapsed. Affected: README.md ×2, plan.md ×3, docs/ifleet-integration-adrs.md ×1, docs/proposer-spec.md ×1, docs/quota-pacing-design.md ×1.
findings.fix_sketch: Replace all occurrences of '56 days overdue as of 2026-07-30' → '59 days overdue as of 2026-08-02' and '70 days elapsed as of 2026-07-30' → '73 days elapsed as of 2026-08-02'.
findings.fix_summary: Updated stale day counts in README.md (×2), plan.md (×3), docs/ifleet-integration-adrs.md (×1), docs/proposer-spec.md (×1), docs/quota-pacing-design.md (×1): 56→59 days overdue, 70→73 days elapsed, as-of date 2026-07-30→2026-08-02.
